title: Bind a value with let
description: You can compute a value once and reuse its local name.

steps.description: The binding expression (+ 2 3) computes 5. let gives that value the local name x.
The extra parentheses surround the list of binding pairs. This let contains one pair.

steps.question: What value does (* x x) use for each x?

steps.description: The body multiplies the bound value by itself. The displayed result is 25.
